name: Can I finance aging-in-place home improvements?

mainEntity.name: Can I finance aging-in-place home improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, several financing options exist for aging-in-place home improvements. These can include home equity loans or lines of credit (HELOCs), reverse mortgages for eligible seniors, or personal loans. Some state and local programs, as well as non-profit organizations, may offer grants or low-interest loans for accessibility modifications. It's recommended to research these options and consult with a financial advisor to determine the best fit for your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing options for aging-in-place improvements include home equity loans, HELOCs, reverse mortgages, personal loans, and potentially state or non-profit grants or low-interest loans.
